negative_findings.description: Robert Walters was named in the cell brief, but cs and en searches returned only Robert Walters Germany, Switzerland and Africa banking/financial-services pages plus unrelated CZ business-register entries for a person named 'Robert Walter'. No evidence surfaced of a Robert Walters Czech Republic office or CZ salary survey.
negative_findings.result_summary: No CZ-specific Robert Walters entity or publication found in this pass; the CZ market appears to be covered by Hays, Grafton, Reed, Randstad, Manpower and the retained-search boutiques instead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents allocating collection effort to a source that may not exist for CZ; if Robert Walters covers CZ it is likely served remotely from Germany/Austria, so the DE site would be the place to look.

negative_findings.description: Talentica s.r.o. (talentica.cz), named in the cell brief, self-describes as a specialist agency for technically oriented professionals in automotive, mechanical/electrical engineering, electronics and IT, based in Prague 6 and Brno.
negative_findings.result_summary: Talentica is not a financial-services recruiter; no banking/payments salary or hiring publications found.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Should be dropped from the CZ banking HR watchlist to avoid noise, unless tracked narrowly for bank IT/engineering hiring spillover.

negative_findings.description: Grafton Recruitment's full salary survey is explicitly distributed only to current or prospective client HR departments in electronic form; Hays' full guide and several Randstad/Reed reports appear to sit behind registration forms.
negative_findings.result_summary: The richest per-position banking pay data from recruiters is gated; only summary pages and press releases are openly collectable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must rely on PR republication (kurzy.cz, e15.cz, penize.cz, hrnews.cz) as the open proxy layer, or on a legitimate client relationship for the full datasets.

negative_findings.description: No CZ recruiter or headhunter was found publishing a dedicated banking/payments-only hiring or salary report; banking appears as one sector inside general multi-sector guides (Hays 12 specialisations, Grafton 9 sectors, Manpower MEOS 'finance, pojišťovnictví a nemovitosti').
negative_findings.result_summary: Sector granularity must be reconstructed from sector chapters and index values rather than from a dedicated banking talent report.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Sets realistic expectations for extraction: the unit of collection is a sector chapter or a single index number, not a standalone banking report.

negative_findings.description: Personalista.com resolves over plain HTTP and search snippets showed mangled diacritics, suggesting a legacy/possibly semi-abandoned site. No fetch was performed to confirm.
negative_findings.result_summary: Listed as a candidate with low priority and an encoding caveat; liveness and update cadence unverified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic verification pass should confirm whether the site still publishes before any crawler is pointed at it.

coverage_gaps.description: Local CZ-owned financial-services recruitment boutiques (as opposed to global brands) were not systematically enumerated in this pass — e.g. firms specialising in banking back-office, risk/compliance and insurance distribution recruitment.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted cs queries such as 'personální agentura specializace bankovnictví pojišťovnictví Praha', 'recruitment risk compliance banka Praha agentura', and enumerate members of the CZ staffing association APPS (Asociace poskytovatelů personálních služeb).

coverage_gaps.description: LinkedIn is where CZ recruiters and headhunters post the most timely 'which functions are banks hiring' commentary and where leadership moves surface first, but it was not collected here and is login-walled.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define a compliant LinkedIn monitoring approach (company pages of Hays CZ, Grafton CZ, Manpower CZ, Amrop CZ, Boyden, Stanton Chase Prague) or substitute with their own blog/RSS feeds; document ToS constraints before any automated access.

coverage_gaps.description: Job-board demand data (LMC's Jobs.cz/Prace.cz reports, Profesia/Alma Career job-posting indices, Atmoskop employer reviews) was only touched at the edges; these give posting-volume time series per sector that lead recruiter guides.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Scout LMC report (report.lmc.eu), Jobs.cz labour-market analyses and Profesia CZ posting statistics as a dedicated follow-up, filtering to bankovnictví/pojišťovnictví categories.

coverage_gaps.description: Historical editions of the recruiter salary guides (needed to build multi-year banking pay and demand series) were only incidentally observed (one 2021 Hays PDF).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate archived PDF editions per recruiter via site search and Wayback Machine, and record a per-source archive URL pattern.

coverage_gaps.description: No URL in this slice was fetched; all entries rest on search-result evidence only, and several (Grafton 2026 page, Reed CZ guide, Finak article series) need liveness and cadence confirmation.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Pass all URLs to the deterministic liveness/verification stage; treat 403s from recruiter sites as bot-defence rather than death.

brief: The CZ HR/recruitment intelligence layer for banking splits into three tiers: (1) recurring quantitative instruments — ManpowerGroup's quarterly Index trhu práce with an explicit finance/insurance sector index, plus the annual Hays Mzdový průzkum, Grafton salary survey/Mozaika pracovního trhu, Randstad's salary-benefits and employer-brand studies, and Reed's CZ guide; (2) retained executive search boutiques with Prague offices (Amrop, Boyden, Stanton Chase, Hays Executive) whose practice pages and placement news carry leadership-move signals; and (3) a dense Czech-language pointer layer — hrnews.cz, hrforum.cz (Asociace personalistů/People Management Forum), personalista.com, plus PR wires kurzy.cz, e15.cz and penize.cz — that republishes the gated recruiter reports in open form. No recruiter publishes a banking-only CZ report: sector signal must be reconstructed from sector chapters and index values. Two non-obvious high-value finds sit outside the classic recruiter set: finak.cz's monthly tally of financial-adviser moves between distribution networks, and the sector trade union OSPPP, which surfaces headcount, branch-closure and collective-bargaining pressure at named banks.
